-- Conquest of Azeroth clients list extra map files (starting-area, cave and custom
-- zone maps, often lowercased). Resolve them from the client's own WorldMapArea
-- data first, then by case-insensitive match against the stock names.
local function FindZoneData(continent, zoneData, mapName)
	local data = zoneData[mapName]
	if data or type(mapName) ~= "string" then return data end
	local lowered = mapName:lower()
	local coa = ZygorAstrolabeCoAZoneData and ZygorAstrolabeCoAZoneData[continent]
	if coa and coa[lowered] then
		Astrolabe.UsesCoAZoneData = true -- lets the rest of the addon know it runs on a CoA client
		return coa[lowered]
	end
	for name, candidate in pairs(zoneData) do
		if type(name) == "string" and name:lower() == lowered then return candidate end
	end
end

Astrolabe.MissingZoneData = {}
for continent, zones in pairs(Astrolabe.ContinentList) do
	local mapData = WorldMapSize[continent];
	for index, mapName in pairs(zones) do
		--print (index,mapName)
		local data = rawget(mapData, "zoneData") and FindZoneData(continent, mapData.zoneData, mapName)
		if data then
			mapData.zoneData[mapName] = data
		elseif rawget(mapData, "zoneData") then
			--WE HAVE A PROBLEM!!!
			-- Recorded rather than printed: CoA clients list maps (minigames, instanced
			-- islands) that have no place on a continent, and a line each is chat spam.
			table.insert(Astrolabe.MissingZoneData, (select(index, GetMapZones(continent))) or tostring(mapName))
			mapData.zoneData[mapName] = zeroData;
		end
		mapData[index] = rawget(mapData, "zoneData") and mapData.zoneData[mapName] or zeroData;
	end
	if rawget(mapData, "zoneData") then mapData.zoneData = nil; end
end

TomTom.lua.new:
local reverseMapFileC = {}
local reverseMapFileZ = {}

-- Ascension-based clients (Conquest of Azeroth among them) ship their own Astrolabe-0.4 in
-- Interface\LibraryXML, registered with an infinite version so it replaces TomTom's copy.
-- It identifies zones by map area ID (GetCurrentMapAreaID) rather than by the zone's index
-- in GetMapZones(), so translate between the two. On other clients nothing changes.
local zoneAreaIDs, areaMapFiles = {}, {}
local usesAreaIDs = GetCurrentMapAreaID ~= nil and Astrolabe.GetVersion ~= nil
	and select(2, Astrolabe:GetVersion()) == math.huge
if usesAreaIDs then
	for C, zones in pairs(Astrolabe.ContinentList) do
		if type(C) == "number" and type(zones) == "table" then
			zoneAreaIDs[C] = {}
			for Z, mapFile in ipairs(zones) do
				SetMapZoom(C, Z)
				local areaID = GetCurrentMapAreaID()
				zoneAreaIDs[C][Z] = areaID
				areaMapFiles[areaID] = mapFile
			end
		end
	end
	SetMapToCurrentZone()

	-- That Astrolabe's ComputeDistance gives up whenever either delta is exactly zero. Small
	-- player movements often leave one map coordinate unchanged between updates, and its
	-- incremental minimap update then removes every icon: the TomTom arrow vanishes a moment
	-- after the player starts moving. Fill in only those cases, from the same world positions.
	if C_WorldMap and C_WorldMap.GetWorldPosition and not Astrolabe.TomTomZeroDeltaFix then
		local computeDistance = Astrolabe.ComputeDistance
		Astrolabe.ComputeDistance = function(self, c1, z1, x1, y1, c2, z2, x2, y2)
			local dist, xDelta, yDelta = computeDistance(self, c1, z1, x1, y1, c2, z2, x2, y2)
			if dist or not (x1 and y1 and x2 and y2) then return dist, xDelta, yDelta end
			local wx1, wy1 = C_WorldMap.GetWorldPosition(z1 or 0, x1, y1)
			local wx2, wy2 = C_WorldMap.GetWorldPosition(z2 or 0, x2, y2)
			if not (wx1 and wy1 and wx2 and wy2) then return nil end
			xDelta, yDelta = wx2 - wx1, wy2 - wy1
			return math.sqrt(xDelta * xDelta + yDelta * yDelta), xDelta, yDelta
		end
		Astrolabe.TomTomZeroDeltaFix = true
	end
end

-- Zone number in the form the active Astrolabe expects, from a GetMapZones() index.
function TomTom:ZoneID(C, Z)
	if usesAreaIDs and Z and Z > 0 then
		return zoneAreaIDs[C] and zoneAreaIDs[C][Z]
	end
	return Z
end

-- Continent and zone number of the map currently shown (zone 0 on a continent map).
function TomTom:CurrentCZ()
	local C, Z = GetCurrentMapContinent(), GetCurrentMapZone()
	if usesAreaIDs and Z and Z > 0 then Z = GetCurrentMapAreaID() end
	return C, Z
end

for C = 1, #Astrolabe.ContinentList do
	for Z = 1, #Astrolabe.ContinentList[C] do
		local mapFile = Astrolabe.ContinentList[C][Z]
		reverseMapFileC[mapFile] = C
		reverseMapFileZ[mapFile] = TomTom:ZoneID(C, Z)
	end
end
